destination.title: Brane and gauge dynamics, geometry and consistency
destination.question: How do brane, gauge and string constructions organize defects, vacua, fixed points, symmetries and quantum consistency across their respective regimes?
destination.summary: This is a proposed navigational scope for the numerical membership. Brane and gauge dynamics provide the main connection; worldsheet radiative constraints, standalone noncommutative perturbation theory and thermal geometry retain distinct access paths. Supersymmetry, holography and Swampland hypotheses are source-specific.

systems: String/M-theory branes and their worldvolume theories
Four-dimensional supersymmetric gauge theories and specified deformations or nonsupersymmetric comparisons
Three-dimensional fixed-point theories and matrix Gross–Neveu–Yukawa models
Adjacent closed-string, noncommutative Yang–Mills and thermal holographic settings
targets: Defects, boundaries, interfaces and their observables
Vacua, conformal manifolds and exact gauge dynamics
Fixed points, RG flows and gravity-decoupled completions
M-brane formulations, topological phases and quantum observables
Radiative constraints and conditional geometric structures
regimes: Source-specific supersymmetric, reduced-supersymmetry and nonsupersymmetric settings
Classical, quadratic, semiclassical, one-loop and planar analyses kept distinct
Infinite N, large finite N and intermediate-rank regimes kept distinct
assumptions: Numerical membership and source-selection roles are candidates, not scientific premises
Each question retains its own physical setting and evidence limits
Conjectures and proposed constructions remain objects of investigation
conventions: Dimensions, gauge groups and supersymmetry notation remain source-specific
Source-scoped singletons do not establish atomicity or cross-source uniqueness
includes: Alternate homes for questions outside a narrower brane/holography core
excludes: A universal supersymmetric, conformal or Einstein-gravity premise
A common mechanism inferred solely from shared terminology
Physical existence inferred solely from anomaly-polynomial solutions

sources.title: Wall-Crossing in Coupled 2d-4d Systems

evidence.text: How does coupling supersymmetric surface defects to 4d N=2 theories modify BPS wall-crossing, and how does the resulting formula govern smooth hyperholomorphic geometry after circle compactification?

sources.title: Swampland conjectures for type IIB orientifolds with closed-string U(1)s

evidence.text: Determine which particle spectra and logical connections among weak gravity, distance and emergence survive the orientifold reduction from N=2 to N=1 supersymmetry.

sources.title: End of the world brane dynamics in holographic 4d $ \mathcal{N} $ = 4 SU(N) with 3d $ \mathcal{N} $ = 2 boundary conditions

evidence.text: How can locally quarter-supersymmetric boundary conditions for 4d N=4 SU(N) SYM admit tractable holographic ETW configurations, and how do their anomalies constrain ETW dynamics and classification?

sources.title: The Hitchhiker's Guide to Tensionless String Limits in 4d SCFTs

evidence.text: What microscopic string backgrounds explain the universality classes of overall weak-coupling, infinite-distance limits of large-N 4d superconformal gauge theories, including theories with non-Einstein holographic duals?

sources.title: Marginal and relevant deformations of N=4 field theories and noncommutative moduli spaces of vacua

evidence.text: Can classical supersymmetric vacua of marginally and relevantly deformed four-dimensional N=4 U(M) theories be organized as noncommutative geometry, and can its representations, center and K-theory explain D-brane fractionation, dual backgrounds and discrete anomalies?

sources.title: Renormalization group flows from holography supersymmetry and a c theorem

evidence.text: Can a supersymmetric nonconformal gauge-theory flow have an explicit, controlled supergravity description, a detailed infrared operator map, and a monotonic holographic function interpolating between fixed-point anomaly coefficients?

sources.title: Wall-Crossing in Coupled 2d-4d Systems

evidence.text: A twisted vacuum-groupoid algebra organizes charge composition and K/S wall-crossing factors. Riemann–Hilbert problems are separated into K-ray and S-ray parts through Yγi=gi xγi; coupled integral equations construct sections from Ω, μ and ω, with a twistor construction recovering the connection.

sources.title: Swampland conjectures for type IIB orientifolds with closed-string U(1)s

evidence.text: Differentiate the Kähler potential, solve geodesics, integrate their length and substitute fixed-label masses. Verify the limit before interpreting the resulting exponent as a distance-conjecture test.

sources.title: End of the world brane dynamics in holographic 4d $ \mathcal{N} $ = 4 SU(N) with 3d $ \mathcal{N} $ = 2 boundary conditions

evidence.text: Reviewed topological reduction gives the schematic bulk action N∫B2 dC2 from ∫F5 B2 dC2, and N∫B2 C2 on a collapsed effective ETW boundary. B2 and C2 encode electric and magnetic 1-form symmetry backgrounds; the fan's wedge coefficients track local five-form flux.

sources.title: The Hitchhiker's Guide to Tensionless String Limits in 4d SCFTs

evidence.text: Worldsheet analysis starts from the CHS linear-dilaton background with supersymmetric SU(2) level-k WZW theory. An equivalent description uses a circle and an N=2 minimal model with Landau–Ginzburg superpotential W=χ^k; normalizable vertex deformations encode NS5 position VEVs.

sources.title: Marginal and relevant deformations of N=4 field theories and noncommutative moduli spaces of vacua

evidence.text: Treat the F-term relations as an associative polynomial algebra A over C; find its center using ordered monomials and solve for finite-dimensional irreducible representations. For general deformations, standard ordering and center calculations become finite linear-algebra problems at each polynomial degree, subject to possible parameter poles.

sources.title: Renormalization group flows from holography supersymmetry and a c theorem

evidence.text: Set fermionic supersymmetry variations to zero to obtain scalar gradient-flow and warp-factor equations. The connecting trajectory is found numerically, with analytic endpoint expansions; the authors report no analytic solution for the full trajectory.

sources.title: Noninvertible Symmetries from Holography and Branes

evidence.text: Can holographic symmetry generators, including noninvertible defects, be extracted systematically from supergravity Gauss constraints and realized by D-brane worldvolume theories, with fusion and action on lines explained by brane dynamics?

sources.title: Non-associative algebras of cubic matrices and their gauge theories

evidence.text: Can ordinary and cubic matrices form a computable non-associative algebra suitable for higher gauge theories, motivated by incorporating M5-brane degrees of freedom into a future extension of Matrix theory?

sources.title: RG fixed points in six-dimensions via branes at orbifold singularities

evidence.text: Which six-dimensional minimally supersymmetric gauge theories with tensor multiplets can support interacting RG fixed points, and can Type I D5 branes at orbifold singularities establish families of such theories?

sources.title: On nonsupersymmetric CFT in four-dimensions

evidence.text: Does the nonsupersymmetric gauge theory on self-dual Type 0 D3-branes inherit all-orders planar finiteness from N = 4 super-Yang–Mills, despite retaining SO(6) global symmetry? The paper also identifies a further SO(6)-invariant central orbifold.

sources.title: Emergent supersymmetry at large N

evidence.text: Can matrix Gross–Neveu–Yukawa theories produce interacting infrared fixed points dominated by planar diagrams, with emergent supersymmetry or controlled non-supersymmetric sectors, and potentially interesting holographic duals?

sources.title: Framed M-branes, corners, and topological invariants

evidence.text: Which framing and corner structures relate M-brane topological actions and anomaly phases to Hopf, Kervaire, f- and ν-invariants, and can the four-sphere jointly describe the C-field and its dual?

sources.title: A Comment on nonsupersymmetric fixed points and duality at large N

evidence.text: Can lifting infinite-N flat directions preserve an interacting nonsupersymmetric three-dimensional fixed point at large finite N, and what statement of IR duality survives?

sources.title: Emergence of $F^4$-couplings in heterotic/type IIA dual string theories

evidence.text: Does a protected six-dimensional F⁴ gauge coupling support the M-theoretic emergence prescription that heavy longitudinally wrapped M5-branes, represented by wrapped D4-branes, need not be integrated out independently in an isotropic M-theory decompactification limit?

sources.title: Casimir effect between world branes in heterotic M theory

evidence.text: What force and instability arise between M-theory boundaries with opposite gaugino chiralities, and what can large-separation calculations establish about their evolution, annihilation and possible fivebrane remnants?

sources.title: N=2 supersymmetric dynamics for pedestrians

evidence.text: How do supersymmetry, electromagnetic duality and Seiberg–Witten geometry describe four-dimensional N=2 gauge dynamics, including strong-coupling singularities and superconformal limits? These pedagogical lectures reinterpret established results using developments associated with Gaiotto duality.

sources.title: One-point functions for doubly-holographic BCFTs and backreacting defects

evidence.text: Determine normalized ambient chiral-primary one-point functions in half-BPS N=4 SYM boundaries, defects and interfaces with many backreacting five-branes, including BCFTs admitting double holography.

sources.title: On the ubiquity of (almost) contact structures in hot MQCD at intermediate coupling

evidence.text: Which G2, almost-contact/contact 3-structures and induced transverse SU(3) structures occur in the thermal-QCD-like M-theory dual, and how does their existence depend on intermediate versus very large N?

sources.title: M-theory boundaries beyond supersymmetry

evidence.text: Can M-theory admit boundary conditions beyond the supersymmetric Horava-Witten E8 wall when boundary supersymmetry is dropped but anomaly inflow is retained?

sources.title: Anti-de Sitter geometry and strongly coupled gauge theories

evidence.text: What M-theory near-horizon backgrounds describe strongly coupled three-dimensional N=4 fixed points with ADE global symmetry, and can their conformal, R-symmetry and ADE symmetries all be identified in spacetime?

sources.title: Supersymmetric Janus Solutions in Four Dimensions

evidence.text: Construct supersymmetric conformal interfaces in the multiple-M2-brane theory using four-dimensional maximal gauged supergravity, including interfaces separating distinct superconformal fixed points.

sources.title: Quantum M2-branes and Holography

evidence.text: Can semiclassically quantised supersymmetric M2-brane saddles account for holographic partition functions, identify the required boundary ensembles, and test whether instanton towers encode perturbative supergravity data?

sources.title: Anomalies, Conformal Manifolds, and Spheres

evidence.text: What restrictions on conformal-manifold geometry, topology and sphere partition functions follow from supersymmetrizing the Weyl anomaly associated with exactly marginal operators?

sources.title: Moduli space of $ \mathcal{N} $ = 4 super Yang-Mills from AdS/CFT

evidence.text: How do smooth holographic solitons encode vacuum selection and the supersymmetric solution space of strongly coupled N=4 SYM on a spatial circle, with two scalar-bilinear VEVs and three R-symmetry current sources?

sources.title: Branes and Non-Invertible Symmetries

evidence.text: Which objects in the IIB holographic dual represent non-invertible symmetries of N=4 theories with algebra so(4N), and how does their worldvolume dynamics produce the fusion rules?

sources.title: Branes and six-dimensional supersymmetric theories

evidence.text: How can brane configurations realize anomaly-free six-dimensional (0,1) theories, their proposed interacting strong-coupling fixed points, small-instanton transitions, and ultraviolet completions with gravity decoupled?

sources.title: M five-brane and superconformal (0,2) tensor multiplet in six-dimensions

evidence.text: How does gauge fixing the single M5-brane produce an interacting six-dimensional (0,2) tensor multiplet, when does its quadratic action possess rigid superconformal symmetry, and how is that symmetry related to the near-horizon geometry?

destination.title: Corrections to moduli geometry, stabilization and control
destination.question: How do quantum, higher-derivative and nonperturbative effects modify moduli dynamics, and under which source-specific conditions can stabilization and its applications remain reliable?
destination.summary: The proposed family accommodates different systems, dimensions and methods. Perturbative Kähler-volume stabilization provides one core direction. Generic geometric and uplift settings supply adjacent questions; other compactifications and order-one-modulus proposals retain separate access. Numerical membership alone establishes neither shared premises nor fine question identity.

systems: Five-dimensional orbifold supergravity and lower-dimensional effective moduli theories
targets: Corrected Kähler geometry, kinetic terms and scalar potentials
Perturbative control, uplift response and additional-field stability
Soft terms, mass scales, vacuum energy and inflation
regimes: Large-volume and weak-coupling expansions where explicitly specified
Order-one desert-point proposals as a separate control boundary
assumptions: Topology, flux tuning, spectator stabilization and uplift ingredients remain source-specific
A correction calculation does not by itself establish a stabilized vacuum
Older and pre-Swampland questions remain eligible
conventions: Geometric Kähler sizes do not automatically include stabilized axions
Positive saddles, de Sitter hills and metastable minima are distinct targets
Corrections to Kähler coordinates, Kähler potentials and superpotentials remain distinguishable
Source-object graph relations retain their exact contextual meaning
includes: Conditional proposals, comparative surveys and methodological inputs
Useful alternate homes for generic geometry, additional-field and uplift questions
excludes: Universal existence or control claims inferred from numerical membership
Automatic equivalence of sources sharing an overview card
Unprovided later revisions, retractions or current-status assessments

sources.title: Jumping Through Loops: On Soft Terms from Large Volume Compactifications

evidence.text: Can loops replace the usual negative-Euler-characteristic requirement or improve purely perturbative Kähler stabilization?

sources.title: Jumping Through Loops: On Soft Terms from Large Volume Compactifications

evidence.text: Are selected string-loop corrections compatible with stabilization and soft supersymmetry breaking in an assumed type-IIB large-volume vacuum?

sources.title: Lifetime of Stringy de Sitter Vacua

evidence.text: Can perturbative corrections alone stabilize a volume modulus and leave a broad decompactification barrier after a consistent uplift?

sources.title: Moduli Redefinitions and Moduli Stabilisation

evidence.text: How do possible one-loop logarithmic redefinitions relating chiral Kähler coordinates to physical cycle volumes affect LARGE-volume stabilization, supersymmetry breaking and visible-sector soft terms?

sources.title: Moduli Stabilising in Heterotic Nearly Kähler Compactifications

evidence.text: Can gauge-field backreaction at order α′ be computed in heterotic nearly Kähler compactifications, and can the resulting domain-wall runaway be lifted by nonperturbative effects to a maximally symmetric vacuum?

sources.title: Four Kahler Moduli Stabilisation in type IIB Orientifolds with K3-fibred Calabi-Yau threefold compactification

evidence.text: Can suitable K3-fibred Type IIB orientifolds support gaugino-condensation and poly-instanton superpotentials, and can these effects with α′ corrections consistently stabilize four Kähler volume moduli while remaining compatible with string-loop corrections?

sources.title: Impacts of non-geometric moduli on effective theory of 5D supergravity

evidence.text: How do vector-multiplet moduli beyond the radion modify the four-dimensional effective Kähler potential of 5D supergravity on S¹/Z₂, and can their one-loop effects support an exponentially large stabilized extra dimension?

sources.title: Higher-Derivative Supergravity and Moduli Stabilization

evidence.text: Which auxiliary-field branch of ghost-free four-derivative N=1 theories is compatible with effective field theory, and can the induced scalar-potential corrections stabilize flat directions and type IIB Kähler volumes using perturbative effects?

sources.title: Type IIA flux vacua and $\alpha'$-corrections

evidence.text: How do perturbative α′ corrections in the Kähler sector modify type IIA flux potentials, their bilinear flux–axion representation, and conditions for non-supersymmetric Minkowski and supersymmetric AdS vacua?

sources.title: F-theory vacua and $\alpha'$-corrections

evidence.text: Which eight-derivative M-theory couplings induce corrections to four-dimensional N=1 F-theory Kähler geometry, and could their proposed no-scale breaking support perturbative moduli stabilization?

sources.title: Logarithmic loop corrections, moduli stabilisation and de Sitter vacua in string theory

evidence.text: Can perturbative string corrections overcome the Kähler-volume runaway while preserving large volume and weak coupling? The paper seeks the sign and strength of logarithmic corrections and asks whether magnetic D7-brane D-terms can uplift the resulting volume minimum.

sources.title: Single-field slow-roll effective potential from Kähler moduli stabilizations in type-IIB/F-theory

evidence.text: Can a combination of perturbative Kähler-potential corrections, one KKLT-type superpotential correction, and D-term uplift yield an effectively single-field plateau potential with a stable de Sitter minimum after Kähler-modulus stabilization?

sources.title: On (de Sitter) vacua in heterotic string theory

evidence.text: Can non-perturbative, stringy, dilaton-dependent corrections to the Kähler potential evade reviewed de Sitter no-go results in heterotic toroidal orbifolds, and what ten-dimensional objects might generate those corrections?

sources.title: Stringy corrections to Kahler potentials, SUSY breaking, and the cosmological constant problem

evidence.text: Can string corrections to the Kähler potential alter KKLT-type moduli stabilization, produce supersymmetry-breaking AdS/Minkowski/metastable de Sitter minima, and permit a one-loop corrected cosmological constant much smaller than the supersymmetry-breaking scale?

sources.title: R**4 corrections to heterotic M-theory

evidence.text: How do eleven-dimensional R⁴ corrections at order κ^{4/3} modify heterotic M-theory’s universal-modulus Kähler potential, soft supersymmetry breaking, warped geometry and previously proposed de Sitter vacua?

sources.title: Kahler corrections for the volume modulus of flux compactifications

evidence.text: What is the parametric form of finite supergravity one-loop corrections to a single no-scale volume modulus, what potential do they induce after small supersymmetry breaking, and can their competition with α′ corrections stabilize the volume?

sources.title: On volume stabilization by quantum corrections

evidence.text: Can known string-loop and tree-level α′ corrections to the Kähler potential stabilize the volume of an N=1 type IIB orientifold at large volume, without a nonperturbative superpotential?

sources.title: Jumping Through Loops: On Soft Terms from Large Volume Compactifications

evidence.text: The proposed diagnostic compares a candidate DBI-induced tension with a corresponding Chern–Simons charge term under BPS assumptions. Applying it to the listed flux–curvature terms remains heuristic.

sources.title: Lifetime of Stringy de Sitter Vacua

evidence.text: Preserve the axion isometry during stabilization, gauge it with magnetic D7 flux, and use the positive D-term for uplift. The isometry is an input condition, so the construction cannot be transferred unchanged to a shift-breaking superpotential.

sources.title: Moduli Redefinitions and Moduli Stabilisation

evidence.text: Compute soft terms through supergravity F-terms, the inverse Kähler metric, gauge kinetic functions and matter metrics. Treat redefinition in the moduli Kähler potential first, then include it in matter metrics and impose D-term stabilization of the visible cycle.

sources.title: Moduli Stabilising in Heterotic Nearly Kähler Compactifications

evidence.text: Dimensional reduction and a generalized Gukov–Vafa–Witten expression yield K and W. F- and D-term equations, the Dirac index and Breitenlohner–Freedman stability tests analyze stabilization, chirality and extrema.

sources.title: Four Kahler Moduli Stabilisation in type IIB Orientifolds with K3-fibred Calabi-Yau threefold compactification

evidence.text: Uses toric weight data, Stanley–Reisner ideals, intersection numbers, and Mori/Kähler cones. Computes ordinary and equivariant cohomology using Riemann–Roch, Lefschetz fixed-point formulas, and line-bundle tools; PALP supplies polytope information. These calculations identify suitable divisors and orientifold zero-mode splittings.

sources.title: Impacts of non-geometric moduli on effective theory of 5D supergravity

evidence.text: For the stabilization example, expand K and the F-term potential in ξ/N̂, solve the leading minimization conditions, and estimate masses and auxiliary F-terms using further large-aτ_s expansions.

sources.title: Extended No-Scale Structure and $\alpha^{'2}$ Corrections to the Type IIB Action

evidence.text: How does the previously derived GSW string-tree-level α′² correction affect perturbative control and survival of KKLT, LVS and Kähler-uplifted vacua, despite extended no-scale cancellation?

sources.title: Systematics of String Loop Corrections in Type IIB Calabi-Yau Flux Compactifications

evidence.text: Which combinations of quantum corrections and additional sources can stabilize Kähler moduli while preserving a controlled large-volume expansion? The appendix compares mechanisms by their competing potential terms, flux-superpotential magnitude, topology, and gauge-sector assumptions.

sources.title: Perturbative moduli stabilisation in type IIB/F-theory framework

evidence.text: Can logarithmic perturbative corrections to the Kähler potential, combined with magnetic D7-brane D-terms, stabilize geometric Kähler moduli at a de Sitter vacuum without nonperturbative superpotential effects?

sources.title: $\alpha^′$ -Corrections and de Sitter vacua - A mirage?

evidence.text: Can leading perturbative α′ corrections, together with tuned flux superpotential, stabilize Kähler volumes in nonsupersymmetric Minkowski/de Sitter vacua and support Kähler-modulus slow-roll inflation without nonperturbative stabilization?

sources.title: Note on de Sitter vacua from perturbative and non-perturbative dynamics in type IIB/F-theory compactifications

evidence.text: Can perturbative α′ and logarithmic Kähler corrections, combined with a nonperturbative superpotential involving only one Kähler modulus, stabilize a three-modulus model and permit D-term uplift to de Sitter?

sources.title: Bounds on complex structure moduli values for perturbative control

evidence.text: Can complex-structure-dependent Kähler corrections impose upper bounds on moduli values for perturbative control, and can those bounds be expressed through KK and string tower scales?

sources.title: Duality invariant gaugino condensation and one loop corrected Kahler potentials in string theory

evidence.text: How do moduli-dependent string thresholds and one-loop corrections to the Kähler potential modify duality-invariant hidden-sector gaugino condensation, scalar potentials, moduli determination, and dilaton stabilization, with or without massive matter?

sources.title: Resolving spacetime singularities in flux compactifications & KKLT

evidence.text: How do effects non-perturbative in α′ resolve the formally negative conformal factor near negative D3 charge, and can KKLT stabilization and uplift remain reliable when the affected region occupies an O(1) fraction of the compactification?

sources.title: Systematics of the α′ expansion in F-theory

evidence.text: Which perturbative corrections can affect the dilaton and overall-volume dependence of the 4D type IIB/F-theory scalar potential, and which effects first break its no-scale structure?

sources.title: From M-theory higher curvature terms to $\alpha'$ corrections in F-theory

evidence.text: How do known eleven-dimensional higher-curvature couplings modify three-dimensional Kähler coordinates and potentials, and which corrections survive the F-theory uplift and admit a seven-brane interpretation?

sources.title: Moduli self-fixing

evidence.text: Can towers associated with SUSY-breaking no-scale moduli, together with a moduli-dependent species cutoff, generate one-loop stabilization without non-perturbative superpotentials or uplifting?

sources.title: Stabilising all Kähler moduli in perturbative LVS

evidence.text: Can perturbative α′, string-loop and higher-derivative corrections stabilize the overall volume and remaining Kähler size moduli at exponentially large volume, and can additional uplift terms produce de Sitter minima?

sources.title: Logarithmic loop corrections, moduli stabilisation and de Sitter vacua in string theory

evidence.text: Why is stabilization of an expansion modulus difficult in a perturbative regime? The reviewed argument attributes the problem to monotonic finite-order potentials whose competing terms become comparable only when the expansion parameter ceases to be small.

sources.title: On quantum corrected Kahler potentials in F-theory

evidence.text: What is the vector-multiplet Kähler potential of F-theory on K3×K3, including all string-coupling effects and perturbative α′ corrections, and how do modular invariance and an M-theory interpretation organize those corrections?

sources.title: Jumping Through Loops: On Soft Terms from Large Volume Compactifications

evidence.text: Can calculations or symmetries exclude mixed-cycle and higher-loop terms that are less suppressed than the retained α′ effect?

sources.title: One-loop Einstein-Hilbert term in minimally supersymmetric type IIB orientifolds

evidence.text: What are the string one-loop corrections to the string-frame Einstein–Hilbert term in minimally supersymmetric toroidal type IIB orientifolds, as needed for determining quantum corrections to the Einstein-frame moduli Kähler metric?

sources.title: On one-loop corrected dilaton action in string theory

evidence.text: What are the string one-loop corrections to the universal 4d dilaton kinetic term in heterotic and type II N=1 compactifications, and how do these constrain the corrected Kähler potential after accounting for frames and multiplet variables?

sources.title: Field redefinitions and Kähler potential in string theory at 1-loop

evidence.text: Which one-loop field redefinitions and Kähler potential simultaneously make the dilaton/untwisted Kähler-modulus kinetic terms compatible with N=1 supersymmetry and perturbative axionic shifts, and which string amplitudes fix their remaining coefficients?

sources.title: The Euler characteristic correction to the Kähler potential — revisited

evidence.text: Can an explicit reduction of the ten-dimensional type IIB bulk action directly recover the Euler-characteristic correction to the four-dimensional N=1 Kähler potential, while determining the corrected background and field coordinates without assumptions about the superpotential or scalar potential?

sources.title: Systematics of moduli stabilisation in Calabi-Yau flux compactifications

evidence.text: Can leading α′ corrections combined with nonperturbative effects stabilize type IIB compactifications at exponentially large volume without a hierarchically small flux superpotential, and yield stable nonsupersymmetric AdS or uplifted de Sitter vacua? How do the gravitino and string scales depend on flux choices?

sources.title: Systematics of type IIB moduli stabilisation with odd axions

evidence.text: How can F-term scalar potentials and odd-axion stability be treated systematically for arbitrary numbers of type IIB orientifold moduli, including BBHL α′³ corrections and selected string-loop and instanton effects?

sources.title: Remarks on the Effects of Quantum Corrections on Moduli Stabilization and de Sitter Vacua in Type IIB String Theory

evidence.text: Can logarithmic perturbative corrections to the Kähler potential, combined with two non-perturbative superpotential terms and D-term uplift, stabilize the Kähler moduli at metastable de Sitter minima?

sources.title: String loop corrections to Kahler potentials in orientifolds

evidence.text: Determine string one-loop corrections to orientifold Kähler potentials, including open-string moduli, to characterize corrections relevant to scalar potentials, moduli stabilization and brane inflation.

sources.title: On $\alpha'$-effects from $D$-branes in $4d \; \mathcal{N} = 1$

evidence.text: Do gravitational α′²g_s corrections to D7/O7 DBI actions modify the four-dimensional N=1 Kähler potential and coordinates, particularly through a topological log-volume coordinate correction that could break no-scale structure?

sources.title: Systematics of String Loop Corrections in Type IIB Calabi-Yau Flux Compactifications

evidence.text: When can string-loop corrections be neglected in moduli stabilization? The survey distinguishes corrections that bound a mechanism's validity from corrections that generate its stabilizing potential, and it warns that conclusions drawn from a few-modulus model need not survive additional flat directions.

sources.title: Moduli stabilisation and inflation in type IIB/F-theory

evidence.text: Can perturbative corrections in a type IIB/F-theory effective model stabilize Kähler moduli at positive vacuum energy, and can an additional Fayet–Iliopoulos contribution permit volume-modulus slow-roll inflation?

destinations.title: Can loops replace the usual negative-Euler-characteristic requirement or improve purely perturbative Kähler stabilization?
Are selected string-loop corrections compatible with stabilization and soft supersymmetry breaking in an assumed type-IIB large-volume vacuum?
Can perturbative corrections alone stabilize a volume modulus and leave a broad decompactification barrier after a consistent uplift?

How do possible one-loop logarithmic redefinitions relating chiral Kähler coordinates to physical cycle volumes affect LARGE-volume stabilization, supersymmetry breaking and visible-sector soft terms?

Can gauge-field backreaction at order α′ be computed in heterotic nearly Kähler compactifications, and can the resulting domain-wall runaway be lifted by nonperturbative effects to a maximally symmetric vacuum?

Can suitable K3-fibred Type IIB orientifolds support gaugino-condensation and poly-instanton superpotentials, and can these effects with α′ corrections consistently stabilize four Kähler volume moduli while remaining compatible with string-loop corrections?

How do vector-multiplet moduli beyond the radion modify the four-dimensional effective Kähler potential of 5D supergravity on S¹/Z₂, and can their one-loop effects support an exponentially large stabilized extra dimension?

Which auxiliary-field branch of ghost-free four-derivative N=1 theories is compatible with effective field theory, and can the induced scalar-potential corrections stabilize flat directions and type IIB Kähler volumes using perturbative effects?

How do perturbative α′ corrections in the Kähler sector modify type IIA flux potentials, their bilinear flux–axion representation, and conditions for non-supersymmetric Minkowski and supersymmetric AdS vacua?
Which eight-derivative M-theory couplings induce corrections to four-dimensional N=1 F-theory Kähler geometry, and could their proposed no-scale breaking support perturbative moduli stabilization?

Can perturbative string corrections overcome the Kähler-volume runaway while preserving large volume and weak coupling? The paper seeks the sign and strength of logarithmic corrections and asks whether magnetic D7-brane D-terms can uplift the resulting volume minimum.

Can a combination of perturbative Kähler-potential corrections, one KKLT-type superpotential correction, and D-term uplift yield an effectively single-field plateau potential with a stable de Sitter minimum after Kähler-modulus stabilization?

Can non-perturbative, stringy, dilaton-dependent corrections to the Kähler potential evade reviewed de Sitter no-go results in heterotic toroidal orbifolds, and what ten-dimensional objects might generate those corrections?

Can string corrections to the Kähler potential alter KKLT-type moduli stabilization, produce supersymmetry-breaking AdS/Minkowski/metastable de Sitter minima, and permit a one-loop corrected cosmological constant much smaller than the supersymmetry-breaking scale?

How do eleven-dimensional R⁴ corrections at order κ^{4/3} modify heterotic M-theory’s universal-modulus Kähler potential, soft supersymmetry breaking, warped geometry and previously proposed de Sitter vacua?

What is the parametric form of finite supergravity one-loop corrections to a single no-scale volume modulus, what potential do they induce after small supersymmetry breaking, and can their competition with α′ corrections stabilize the volume?
Can known string-loop and tree-level α′ corrections to the Kähler potential stabilize the volume of an N=1 type IIB orientifold at large volume, without a nonperturbative superpotential?
